title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.12.1 corrects the cavity validation lesson so its default output shows actual native CFD against Ghia at Re=100,400,1000, grid changes, signed errors and recomputed raw/screened norms. The homepage now shows this validation figure and held-out neural-profile predictions, and distinguishes the existing low-Re full-field POD-DeepONet from the seven-Re centreline regression experiment. Eight retained CFD archives are hash-checked and their original metrics reproduced; earlier notebooks, raw solver fields and frozen neural fits are preserved. The four higher-Re CFD fields remain missing; the neural fit does not substitute for them. This patch retains the three cavity labs and four lecture additions of v1.12.0 within the broader FlowMLLab CFD and scientific-machine-learning course.
